known_consumers: Five concrete examples in Tests.OnlineOptimisticFTRLCanary make twelve uses of the general results: asymmetric hints, regularizer drift, the true dual on a box, announced zero curvature, and a continuum of terminal minimizers.

reuse_plan.decision_reason: Keep A_t strict-past and hinted, G_t inclusive and unhinted. Reuse the arbitrary-terminal algebra and original-norm convex analysis; do not apply the BTRL regret theorem to a different algorithm.

semantic_roundtrip.remaining_semantic_delta: The sharp theorem permits specified nonnegative inclusive curvature; its terminal minimizer exists but need not be unique at zero. The dual Young expression requires positive chosen moduli. Repeating the hint instead requires its terminal residual. A relative support on V is not automatically an ambient support on X. This contract alone accepts no proof or chapter.
